title: Assistant ignores tenant documents (v3)
description: Wayne Foods says answers are generic and never quote their uploaded manuals. First suspicion was model quality at the gateway, then retrieval.
resolution_notes: Effective top_k for the tenant was 2 due to a tenant override set by Team B during a cost experiment. The manual section ranks 5th, so it never reaches context. g.retrieval showed n_chunks=2. Removed the override (default top_k=8 on v3). Not a model or RAG bug.
